purpose: Train the fresh two-agent MAPPO R1 baseline with the signed-longitudinal two-dimensional action protocol while holding reward, critic and scenario design fixed.

parameter_rationale.action_protocol: The actor controls signed longitudinal demand and steering. A fixed continuous dead zone d=0.05 maps positive demand to throttle, negative demand to brake and the central interval to coast; CARLA still receives throttle, steer and brake. This removes the redundant throttle/brake competition while preserving bounded actuation.
parameter_rationale.causal_scope: Reward v2, AgentConditionedCritic, observations, scenarios and all PPO hyperparameters remain unchanged from the diagnosed R0 pilot so R1 isolates the action-protocol intervention.
parameter_rationale.ppo_epochs: Five epochs limits policy non-stationarity while retaining the frozen R0 optimization setting.
parameter_rationale.minibatch_size: 32768 covers the worst-case two-agent critic batch from 16 episodes x 1000 steps, preserving one full batch per epoch.
parameter_rationale.clip_and_kl: clip_eps=0.15 and target_kl=0.02 are retained unchanged for causal traceability.
parameter_rationale.discount_and_gae: gamma=0.997 and lambda=0.95 preserve the prior long-horizon bias-variance design.
parameter_rationale.learning_rates: Actor and critic learning rates remain 3e-4 with gradient norm 0.5 and decay over 100 updates.
parameter_rationale.exploration: entropy coefficient 0.03 and init_log_std=0.0 are retained; new policy-action dead-zone and saturation rates are preregistered monitoring signals.
parameter_rationale.seed_policy: Seed 42 remains the single engineering pilot seed; multi-seed confirmation is outside R1.
